up: Retrieve the ChEMBL identifiers (chembl_id) and preferred names (pref_name) for molecules that have both a valid structure in the compound_structures table and a non-null preferred name in the molecule_dictionary table. Join molecule_dictionary and compound_structures on molregno. Filter for records where pref_name IS NOT NULL. Return only the requested columns without any ranking or row limits.
sql: SELECT md.chembl_id, md.pref_name FROM molecule_dictionary md JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE md.pref_name IS NOT NULL
